about: Where a heredoc ends, shape by shape, as seven shells read it (claude-config#3592). One list, run by the suites of both readers that had the fault: lib/shell_code_lines.py, which the tree scans read shell files through (test-shell-code-lines.sh), and the mods' reader, mods/mod-kit/hooks/commands.ts (mods/mod-kit/tests/commands.test.ts). A row's text only prints. Each probe line is `echo Pnn`, nn its line number: run as a command it prints Pnn at the start of a line, and kept as a heredoc's body cat prints it with its echo in front. `lines` says which of the two every shell did with each probe line, or, where they differ, which shells did which. `named` says whether each reader must name the heredoc as one it is not sure of: it must wherever its own reading is not what every shell does, and it must not on the controls, so naming every heredoc passes nothing. test-shell-code-lines.sh runs every row through each shell here that prints what `prints` records for its `probe`, on the system `os` names, so the list cannot say what those shells do not do. Any other shell is a part that suite prints as not measured.
measured: 2026-11-25 on macOS, each text as a -c text and as a file, which agreed in every row
